//: Yard Guide cards whose published description must not be shown as it is (assets/covers/covers.json is the live blog's text). Each entry replaces that card's text on every page that shows it with {{GUIDE_CARDS}}, unless the page gives its own wording in "guideCards". The Yard Guide index is generated by the family's script and carries the same sentence. An entry may hold "alt" as well as, or in place of, "text": the description of the card's picture for people who cannot see it, used the same way (a page's own "guideCards" alt comes first). The 17 entries that hold only "alt" were added on October 12, 2026: the published descriptions of those covers are workshop wording ("faithful brown Purge Pros character", "Approved real cleanup tools ... restrained blue callout").

weekly-or-one-time-dog-poop-cleanup.text: Compare recurring and one-time dog poop cleanup for your Indianapolis-area yard: service scope, starting prices and route review.
weekly-or-one-time-dog-poop-cleanup.why: The live description says "the first-cleanup offer"; the first cleanup is never called an offer (POLICY-WORDING.md). The live card is in the policy change set.
